figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Bioinformatic analysis of P450-modified RiPP BGCs. A) Genome mining of P450 enzymes using TrpB (WP_009069821.1), CitB
(ABF92778.1), and BytO (NMO15105.1) as query sequences. The SSN was constructed using P450 sequences from NCBI Database. Sequences
with 90% identity were zipped to one node. Nodes are colored based on corresponding putative precursor peptides. The yellow V-shaped nodes
were characterized in this study. B) Organization of P450-modified RiPP BGCs and sequence logos of precursor peptides predicted by RiPPer and
manual analysis. The class numbers of BGCs and precursor peptides are consistent with corresponding P450 classes. In each BGC class, precursor
peptide genes are shown as black cassettes, P450 genes are shown as red cassettes and other modification genes are shown as gray cassettes (AT:
acetyltransferase, cupin: cupin_domain protein, MT: methyltransferase). For each precursor class, aromatic amino acid residues, including Trp
(W), Tyr (Y), and His (H), are colored red.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Heterologous expression of P450-modified RiPP BGCs from Class 3 using S. albus J1074 as an expression host. A) Selected BGCs from
Class 3 for heterologous expression. B) HPLC analysis of culture extracts from recombinant i) S. albus/tsuAB, ii) S. albus/tsuAC, iii) S. albus/tsuABC,
iv) S. albus/oliAB, v) S. albus/oliAC, vi) S. albus/oliABC, vii) S. albus/azaAB, viii) S. albus/azaA*B, ix) S. albus/yokAB, x) S. albus/yokA*B strains and
xi) S. albus J1074. C–F) Structures of identified cross-linked products formed by catalysis by P450 enzymes from Class 3.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Heterologous expression of P450-modified RiPP BGCs from Class 9 using S. albus J1074 as an expression host. A) Selected RiPP BGCs
from Class 9 for heterologous expression. B) HPLC analysis of culture extracts from recombinant i) S. albus/sanAB×2, ii) S. albus/syrAB×2, iii) S.
albus/creAB×2 strains harboring 2 copies of san, syr, cre BGC, respectively (HPLC chromatogram of recombinant strains harboring a single BGC
copy was shown in Figure S10); iv) S. albus J1074. Peaks marked with an asterisk represent minor products for which structures could not be
identified. C–E) Structures of identified cross-linked products formed by catalysis by P450 enzymes from Class 9.
